basic_info.description: Quintessential updated Victorian on wide tree-lined street offering 3 beds/ 2 baths on one level, lush walk-out back yard, plenty of storage space and ideal Bernal Heights location. This 3bd/2.5ba home spans 1,750 SF (per tax) and features a light-filled floor plan ideal for everyday living and entertaining. A formal living room with bay windows flows into a flexible double parlor, ideal for a home office, playroom or guest bedroom. The well-appointed kitchen connects naturally to the dining room and opens to a beautifully landscaped rear yard, complete with a built-in firepit, custom bench seating, mini-fridge, and plumbed-in fire table and grill. Upstairs offers 3 bedrooms and 2 recently renovated full baths on one level, including a primary suite. Spacious 1-car garage with extra-wide 9-foot door, work area, laundry room and plenty of space for storage. Located in prime Bernal Heights with a walk score of 87, enjoy proximity to Precita Park (3-min), Bernal Heights Park (10-min), and Cortland Avenue shops (17-min). Easy access to 101/280 freeways and 24th St BART.
